title: Reflection as Data
description: AIL 606 textbook section connecting reflection as data to the reflection codebook with coded excerpts and decision-linkage trace, reader notes, support moments, and revision evidence.

learning_objectives.statement: Distinguish a global impression (uncodeable) from an analytic excerpt that names a feature and a learner action
Apply a defined code to an excerpt and link the code to a specific design decision
Keep the inference modest: treat reflection as evidence of perceived experience, not as a measured learning gain, and pair it with a planned check
Reject coding that reads competence into a reaction

alignment_method: deterministic lexical mapping v2 with direct-evidence fallback; instructor review required
